Q: How to Handle Browser Popup (During the Download) using Java A:

This is actually a windows pop up and firebug will not able to detect this.If you are using windows OS then you can use AutoIT tool this will solve your problem.

Q: htaccess Redirect to URL with no page ID and new directory A:

I think you need to replace your current RedirectMatch line with the following code in your .htaccess file:

RedirectMatch 301 ^/media-center/\d+-(.+)$ /news-insights/$1

Also, I think you should try it in incognito mode first to confirm.

Q: Filling Null values with MEDIAN in Oracle Database table A: 

CREATE TABLE new_table AS
SELECT
    pk_id,
    NVL(column_name, MEDIAN(column_name) OVER ()) AS column_name
FROM table_origin;

Q: Unable to view mongodb locally hosted on our server in compass A:

Try to Allow IP address from anywhere in Your project.

Q: c++11 order of evaluation confusion A:

Minor point: "sequence point" to "sequenced-before" was precisely to accommodate threading. But the change was purely to terminology: it did not (was not supposed to, I suppose) affect the meaning of any valid pre-C++11 program.
